Economy · India

US Imposes 10% Tariff on Indian Imports, Trade Talks Continue

The United States has imposed a 10% tariff on certain Indian imports. This move has led to mixed reactions from Indian exporters who are assessing the impact on their competitiveness. Despite the new tariffs, India has stated its intention to continue engaging with the US on a trade deal. Some reports indicate that specific sectors like generic medicines and smartphones may receive exemptions or relief. The US has also warned against excessive yen volatility and called for Bank of Japan rate hikes.
